# Sample AI output: coding Skill on the six field notes

**What this is:** an example of what the `qual-coding-message-purpose` Skill produces on `data/fieldnotes.csv`. The Skill saves it as `coded-fieldnotes.csv`; it's shown here as a table so it's easy to read. Use it in Part 3 (Try 3 and the discussion after it) if you don't have AI access or get stuck.

**Provenance:** generated by Claude (Opus 5.5) on 22 Oct 2026, following `skills/qual-coding/SKILL.md`. Your own run will differ in wording, and possibly in some calls. That variation is part of the point.

The earlier version, coded with boyd's networked-publics affordances, is in `sample-ai-output-boyd.md`.

---

| id | code | evidence | confidence | rationale |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FN-01 | remembering | "mostly "my grandma used to bring me here" stories" | high | Members use the old photo to share personal memories of the market. |
| FN-01 | group-rules | "The admin pinned it." | low | An admin action, but pinning may just be housekeeping rather than a rule; arguable. |
| FN-01 | other: passing on food heritage | "the only place my kids hear about these stalls" | medium | The group is framed as a way of handing knowledge of stalls to the next generation. |
| FN-02 | asking | "asked whether a char kway teow stall at a hawker centre in Ang Mo Kio is "still good"" | high | A genuine question to the group about a stall. |
| FN-02 | sharing-news | "replied with links to old messages in the group from 2023" | medium | Members answer by pointing to earlier information; not `remembering`, as the old messages are used as a source. |
| FN-02 | group-rules | "scroll up lah, we discussed already" | high | Inferred: a gentle telling-off that teaches the newcomer to check earlier messages before asking. |
| FN-02 | complaining | "the search bar "doesn't find anything" when she types the stall name in Chinese" | low | Reports a problem with the platform; the field note doesn't show whether she was frustrated. |
| FN-03 | sharing-news | "last week before he retires!!" | high | Passes on news about a stall owner retiring. |
| FN-03 | sharing-news | "forwarded to at least three other groups" | medium | Inferred: the news was passed on by others, beyond the original group. |
| FN-03 | group-rules | "asked the original poster to take the uncle's face out of the photo" | medium | A request about what should be shared. |
| FN-03 | other: consent | "asked the original poster to take the uncle's face out of the photo" | medium | The person pictured did not choose to be shared; raises a consent question within the community. |
| FN-03 | ETHICS-FLAG | (photo of an identifiable stall owner described) | n/a | Field note refers to an image showing a real person's face; do not reproduce the image in outputs. |
| FN-04 | complaining | "I wrote it for the group, not for IG." | high | The member objects to their review being reposted elsewhere. |
| FN-04 | group-rules | "ask first next time" | high | The admin commits to a new practice about reposting. |
| FN-04 | group-rules | "but the IG is public what, anyone can see anyway" | medium | A competing view of what may be shared; could also be read as disagreeing with the complaint. |
| FN-04 | judging-food | "reposted a member's review" | low | The reposted content was a food review, but the excerpt is about the repost, not the food; arguable. |
| FN-04 | other: credit | "reposted a member's review without crediting them" | medium | Authorship and credit are at stake, not only where the review was shared. |
| FN-05 | other: reading without posting | "She reads the group "like the newspaper", every morning, but rarely posts." | medium | Describes a routine, mostly receptive way of taking part. None of the codes fit, because they describe messages and this is a habit. |
| FN-05 | judging-food | "keeps a paper notebook of stalls people recommend" | low | She collects other members' recommendations rather than making her own; arguable. |
| FN-06 | judging-food | "a member's harsh review of a stall that has since closed" | medium | The resurfaced screenshot is a negative review of a stall. |
| FN-06 | other: regret over old posts | "I was young and hungry, pls delete" | medium | The original author wants an old post removed. |
| FN-06 | group-rules | "Admin said Telegram doesn't let them delete other people's old messages" | medium | The admin explains what the group can and can't remove. |
| FN-06 | remembering | "members sharing what they miss about stalls that have closed" | high | Members recall stalls that are gone. |

### For the researcher to check

- **Low confidence:** FN-01 group-rules (pinning), FN-02 complaining (search bar), FN-04 judging-food (the repost), FN-05 judging-food (her notebook).
- **Other labels to review:** passing on food heritage, consent, credit, reading without posting, regret over old posts. Credit and consent both concern who controls a post: candidate for a new code?
- **ETHICS-FLAG:** FN-03 (identifiable face in a shared photo).
- **Inferred, not stated:** FN-02 group-rules (telling-off); FN-03 forwarding as sharing-news.
- **Codebook fit:** FN-05 is an interview about a habit, not a message, so the codes fit it poorly.
